Name: Shard Port
Description: HTTP/WebSocket control (/ws, /health). With a TLS proxy, keep this internal and expose the proxy port instead

Name: UDP Voice Port
Description: UDP voice router. Independent of the Public URL/TLS port; clients are told this port directly. Must be reachable from the internet

Name: TLS Port
Description: HTTPS/WSS port served by the built-in TLS proxy (Let's Encrypt mode only)
